correctness.rationale: Reconstructed deleted-five-run criterion for ordinary k-cut complex of squared cycle C_{k+5}^2: disconnectivity iff two separated deleted runs have length at least two. Independently enumerated all k=3..30 (n=8..35) facet sets, entire face posets, greedy pivot matchings and full directed Hasse acyclicity, reproducing exact critical counts one vertex, n-7 3-cells, beta+n-8 4-cells, beta=n(n-7)(n-8)/6. Independent exact signed Morse differential reductions for n=8,9,12,16,25,30,35 yielded precisely n-8 primitive columns e_i-e_last and no other columns, including the endpoint n=35 with beta=4410. The inspected original finite verifier exhaustively performs signed differential checks for every n=8..35. From the 2-connected 3-skeleton and primitive attaching degrees, homotopy cancellations give S^3 vee beta S^4 for exactly this finite range; no all-k theorem is inferred.
